latitude.description: The approximate latitude of the site in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: The approximate longitude of the site in decimal degrees.

fuel_loads_mmbtu_per_hour.description: Fuel energy consumption for space heating at building level (8760 timeseries). Used in BAU LCCA for the GHP iteration.
fuel_loads_mmbtu_per_hour.note:
This parameter is required to run REopt's GHP module as per the REopt formatting requirements, but is not used to calculate URBANopt's GHP system LCCA.
Users can set this to values close to 0 (but have to be > 0) in the GHP scenario.

fuel_loads_mmbtu_per_hour.description: Fuel consumption for DHW at building level (8760 timeseries). Used in LCCA per iteration context.
fuel_loads_mmbtu_per_hour.note: 15 min interval data do not work in GHP module. Please make sure all timeseries are 8760.

loads_kw.description: Building electric load (kW) for the GHP scenario (8760). Sum of secondary pump, heat pump, and ETS pump powers.
loads_kw.note: 15 min interval data do not work in GHP module. Please make sure all timeseries are 8760.

ElectricTariff.description: Define electric tariff by exactly ONE of: (1) urdb_label, (2) blended_annual_energy_rate, (3) urdb_response.

urdb_label.description: Label attribute of utility rate structure from https://openei.org/services/doc/rest/util_rates/?version=3

blended_annual_energy_rate.description: Annual blended energy rate [$ per kWh] (total annual energy kWh / annual cost $).

urdb_response.description: Utility Rate Database API JSON (if user-provided, ensure periods are zero-indexed).

require_ghp_purchase.description: Always set to true (1) for URBANopt's LCCA.

building_sqft.description: Building footprint area (sq.ft.) used to calculate hydronic loop cost.
building_sqft.note: For the GHX iteration, set building_sqft to 0.

peak_combined_heatpump_thermal_ton.description: Max of GHP heating/cooling capacity (tons) from Modelica; used in GHP LCCA.
peak_combined_heatpump_thermal_ton.note: In the GHX iteration, set to a small positive number (NOT 0).

number_of_boreholes.description: Count from Thermal Network sizing; used in GHX LCCA.
number_of_boreholes.note: In the GHP iteration, set to 0.

length_boreholes_ft.description: Borehole length (ft) from Thermal Network sizing; used in GHX LCCA.
length_boreholes_ft.note: In the GHP iteration, set to 0.

yearly_total_electric_consumption_series.description: 8760 series of building total electric consumption (kW).
yearly_total_electric_consumption_series.note: Set to 0 for all GHP and GHX iterations.

yearly_ghx_pump_electric_consumption_ser.description: 8760 series of district pump electric power (kW); used in GHX LCCA.
yearly_ghx_pump_electric_consumption_ser.note: In the GHP iteration, set to 0.

heating_thermal_load_mmbtu_per_hr.description: Required by REopt formatting; not used for URBANopt GHP LCCA. Set to near-zero positives.

cooling_thermal_load_ton.description: Required by REopt formatting; not used for URBANopt GHP LCCA. Can be zeros.

installed_cost_heatpump_per_ton.description: Installed cost per ton of GHP ($/ton). Optional; defaults may be applied.

installed_cost_ghx_per_ft.description: Installed cost per ft of GHX ($/ft). Optional; defaults may be applied.

installed_cost_building_hydronic_loop_pe.description: Installed cost for building hydronic loop ($/sqft of footprint). Optional; defaults may be applied.

om_cost_per_sqft_year.description: O&M cost ($/sqft-year). Default often negative (savings); 0 recommended for positive NPV clarity.

avoided_capex_by_ghp_present_value.description: Present value of avoided BAU capital expenses.
avoided_capex_by_ghp_present_value.note: Use to capture avoided BAU system cost when switching to GHP for accurate NPV.

fuel_cost_per_mmbtu.description: Fuel cost for existing boiler ($/MMBtu). Required for BAU LCCA; required as formatting in GHP scenario.

elec_cost_escalation_rate_fraction.description: Annual nominal utility electricity cost escalation rate.

om_cost_escalation_rate_fraction.description: Annual nominal O&M cost escalation rate.
